selection: The nine default finite fields plus degree 12 at characteristics 3, 13 and 2147483647, fixed before timing to cover the maximum supported degree. All selected cells are reported.
build: Release, GCC 16.2.1, FASTCD_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON, FASTCD_BUILD_FLINT_BENCHMARK=ON. Exact native flags and source hashes are in results.json; dependency options are in dependency-build.json.
pilot_timing: 0.5 ms target for the faster backend, 24 paired blocks, matching the scalar survey calibration target. The default benchmark setting remains 20 ms.
